question: What did Google report in 2025 about quantum computing with its Willow chip?
text:
On **October 22, 2025**, Google reported that its **Willow** quantum chip ran an algorithm called **Quantum Echoes** in about two hours. Google estimated that the best known classical method would take **13,000 times as long** on one of the world’s fastest supercomputers. The results were published in *Nature*. ([research.google](https://research.google/blog/a-verifiable-quantum-advantage/?utm_source=openai))

Google called it the first **verifiable quantum advantage**: a comparably capable quantum computer could repeat the calculation and check the result. The speedup was for one specific task—measuring how a disturbance spreads through a quantum system—not a claim that Willow is faster than supercomputers at everything. Google also reported a separate proof-of-concept experiment using the technique to study molecular structure. ([blog.google](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/research/quantum-echoes-willow-verifiable-quantum-advantage/?authuser=96))
